heading: Short title and commencement
title: Short title and commencement
text:
1. Short title and commencement.—(1) This Act may be called the Revocation of Privileges Act, 1992.

(2) It shall come into force at once and shall be deemed to have come into force on and from the 3rd day of May, 1992.
